member.name: M:LTRData.Extensions.Native.NativeLib.Win32Try``1(``0)
member.summary: Encapsulates call to a Win32 API function that returns a value where failure is indicated as a NULL return and GetLastError() returns an error code. If non-zero value is passed to this method it just returns that value. If zero value is passed, it calls GetLastError() and throws a managed exception for that error code.
member.param: Return code from a Win32 API function call.
